title: [FR] Add a "description" column in the main panel
body:
### Willingness to contribute

Yes. I would be willing to contribute this feature with guidance from the MLflow community.

### Proposal Summary

Hi thanks for the helpful tool! I would appreciate it if there could be one more row - (run) description - in this page. Then it is easy to glance through all runs with descriptions. IMHO this may not be super hard to implement, 

![image](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/assets/5236035/b76bd614-2090-4154-96f1-40648f52882f)

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
@reporter thanks for filing this FR! I think that if there's a use case for that, we definitely can add the description column. However what concerns me is not the adding the column by itself, but the approach to render its content. Run descriptions can contain a lot of rich content (markdown) and multi-line text. If we were to attempt displaying it as on the run details page, we might inadvertently hinder table readability. Maybe we could just display `n` few first words with no line breaks and use ellipsis (`...`) at the end? 🤔  Does it help with your use case @reporter ?
CC @participant1 also @participant6

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> Maybe we could just display n few first words with no line breaks and use ellipsis (...) at the end?

Yes I think so! And maybe just render as pure text. For example, suppose someone has `## This is title\n\nThis is content`, we may just render as something like `This is title This is content`, instead of the huge title font.
